title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first face, which consists of a single loop. In this loop, draw a circle with its center located at coordinates [0.0272, 0.0272] and a radius of 0.0272. After drawing the first face, apply a scale factor of 0.0544 to the two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. To generate the three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. This operation will create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.054439235294117636 in length, 0.054439235294117636 in width, and 0.75 in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle in the sketch
r = r.center(0.0272, 0.0272).circle(0.0272)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0272, 0.0272)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0272)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)

import cadquery as cq
import math

# Create the cylinder
result = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0272).extrude(0.75)

# Create a plane for the cut
plane = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0544, 0.0544).circle(0.0272)

# Create the cut cylinder
cylinder2 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=0.75) \
    .center(0.0544, 0.0544).circle(0.0272).extrude(-0.75)

# Combine
r = result.cut(cylinder2)

import cadquery as cq

# Cylinder with diameter 0.0544 and height 0.75
cyl = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(0.0544 / 2).extrude(0.75)

# Slot cut through the cylinder along its full length (seen as a line in RIGHT view)
slot_width = 0.004
slot = cq.Workplane("XZ").center(0, 0.375).rect(slot_width, 0.9).extrude(0.2, both=True)

r = cyl.cut(slot)
